name: com.profblu.prim/prim
title: Prim
description: Live audience of Argentine streaming: who is live now, schedule, rankings, people and events.

tools.name: who_is_live_now
tools.description: Lists the Argentine streaming, radio and TV channels that are live right now, ordered by concurrent viewers measured by Prim, with the programme on air, the platforms (YouTube, Twitch, Kick) with their watch links and the canonical url of each channel's page on prim.profblu.com. Optionally filter by channel name. Answers in the language requested with lang (es, en, it).

channel.description: Only this channel (name or slug, e.g. «Luzu TV» or luzu-tv).

limit.description: How many channels, 1 to 50. Defaults to 15.

lang.description: Language of the answer: es (Spanish), en (English) or it (Italian). Defaults to es. Use the language the user writes in.

tools.name: get_schedule
tools.description: What is on Argentine streaming, radio and TV channels on a given day (today by default): each programme with its start and end time in Buenos Aires, the channel, the hosts and whether it is on air now, with the canonical url of each programme's page on prim.profblu.com. Filter by channel to get one channel's day, or ask only for what is on air now. Answers in the language requested with lang (es, en, it).

date.description: Day in Buenos Aires, YYYY-MM-DD, from 7 days ago to 7 days ahead. Defaults to today.

onAirNow.description: true: only what is on air right now (ignores date).

limit.description: How many programmes, 1 to 100. Defaults to 40.

lang.description: Language of the answer: es (Spanish), en (English) or it (Italian). Defaults to es. Use the language the user writes in.

tools.name: get_channel
tools.description: The page of an Argentine streaming, radio or TV channel on Prim: what it is, where to watch it (YouTube, Twitch, Kick), whether it is live now and with how many viewers, its position in this week's audience ranking, its programmes and its upcoming events, with the canonical url of its page on prim.profblu.com. Accepts the channel's name, slug or Prim url. Answers in the language requested with lang (es, en, it).

channel.description: Channel name, slug or Prim url, e.g. «Luzu TV», luzu-tv or https://prim.profblu.com/c/luzu-tv

lang.description: Language of the answer: es (Spanish), en (English) or it (Italian). Defaults to es. Use the language the user writes in.

tools.name: get_person
tools.description: The page of a host, streamer, journalist or guest of Argentine streaming on Prim: who they are, what they do, the programmes they are on now (and whether they are on air or when the next show is), their own channel, their social media and their upcoming events, with the canonical url of their page on prim.profblu.com. Accepts the person's name, nickname, slug or Prim url; a bare first name or nickname shared by several people («Nico») returns found=false with the candidates in suggestions, so ask the user which one. Answers in the language requested with lang (es, en, it).

person.description: Name, nickname, slug or Prim url, e.g. «Migue Granados», «Nico Occhiato» or https://prim.profblu.com/p/migue

lang.description: Language of the answer: es (Spanish), en (English) or it (Italian). Defaults to es. Use the language the user writes in.

tools.name: top_moments
tools.description: Today's most watched moments of Argentine streaming (the audience peaks of the day: channel, programme, the minute it happened and how many people were watching, with a link to that minute on prim.profblu.com) and the clips gaining most views right now. Answers in the language requested with lang (es, en, it).

limit.description: How many peaks and how many clips, 1 to 10. Defaults to 5.

lang.description: Language of the answer: es (Spanish), en (English) or it (Italian). Defaults to es. Use the language the user writes in.

tools.name: weekly_ranking
tools.description: This week's audience ranking of Argentine streaming, radio and TV channels, measured by Prim (Monday to Sunday): position, average and peak concurrent viewers, hours live and the movement against last week, with the canonical url of each channel's page on prim.profblu.com. Answers in the language requested with lang (es, en, it).

limit.description: How many positions, 1 to 50. Defaults to 10.

lang.description: Language of the answer: es (Spanish), en (English) or it (Italian). Defaults to es. Use the language the user writes in.

tools.name: upcoming_events
tools.description: Upcoming live shows, tours, talks and events of Argentine streaming people and channels, in Argentina and abroad: date and time where it happens, venue, city, line-up and ticket link, with the canonical url of each event's page on prim.profblu.com. Filter by city (e.g. Buenos Aires, Córdoba, Madrid), by dates or by a name in the line-up. Answers in the language requested with lang (es, en, it).

query.description: A name in the line-up or in the title, e.g. «Nadie Dice Nada».

from.description: From this day, YYYY-MM-DD (local to the event).

to.description: Until this day, YYYY-MM-DD (local to the event).

limit.description: How many events, 1 to 25. Defaults to 10.

lang.description: Language of the answer: es (Spanish), en (English) or it (Italian). Defaults to es. Use the language the user writes in.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Searches Prim's catalogue of Argentine streaming by name: channels, programmes, people (hosts, streamers, guests) and upcoming events, each with the canonical url of its page on prim.profblu.com. Use it when you only have a name; then get_channel or get_person for the full page. Answers in the language requested with lang (es, en, it).

query.description: What to look for, e.g. «Olga», «Nadie dice nada», «Migue Granados».

limit.description: How many results of each kind, 1 to 10. Defaults to 5.

lang.description: Language of the answer: es (Spanish), en (English) or it (Italian). Defaults to es. Use the language the user writes in.
